Overview

About the clear acrylic sign with printed logo

Our clear acrylic sign is the most popular business sign we make, and it's easy to see why. Your logo is printed onto the back of a crystal-clear acrylic panel, so it's viewed through a polished, glass-like face. The acrylic protects the print from scratches, fingerprints and cleaning, and gives your design real depth.

Behind the colours we add a layer of white ink. Choose spot white to back just your logo, leaving the rest of the panel clear so the wall shows through, or flood white for a solid white panel behind everything. Either way, your brand colours stay bright instead of looking washed out on a dark wall.

Choose 3mm for small door and desk-area signs, 5mm for most wall signs, or 10mm for a heavier, premium look on reception walls. Panels can be made to any size up to 3000 x 2000mm, so this perspex sign with your logo works as a small nameplate or a full reception feature.

It's an acrylic business sign that suits almost any setting: offices, receptions, salons, clinics, dentists, estate agents, solicitors and shopfronts. Reverse-printed acrylic also works outdoors beside an entrance.

Want the logo cut out instead of a rectangle? See the clear acrylic logo sign. Browse all acrylic signs.

Installation & fixing

Polished aluminium stand-offs hold the sign a short distance from the wall, creating a floating effect and a shadow that adds depth. They screw into the wall through drilled holes in the corners of the sign. VHB tape is a strong double-sided adhesive for smooth, sealed walls where you'd rather not drill.

We'll drill the corners to suit the stand-offs. We fit signs across Norfolk and Suffolk.

Step by step

Fitting & care guide

  1. 01Check the wallMake sure the surface is sound, flat and dry. For screws, find out whether it's masonry, timber or plasterboard so you can choose suitable plugs.
  2. 02Position the signHold the sign in place, check it's level with a spirit level, and mark the fixing holes through the pre-drilled corners.
  3. 03Fix itDrill and plug the wall, then fit stand-offs or screws with caps. Don't overtighten: hand-tight is enough and avoids stressing the panel.
  4. 04Using tape instead?For VHB tape, clean the wall and sign back with isopropyl alcohol, apply firm pressure for 30 seconds, and avoid loading the sign for 24 hours while the bond builds.
  5. 05CareClean with a soft cloth and mild soapy water. Avoid abrasive pads and solvent cleaners, which can scratch acrylic or damage printed surfaces.
Artwork

Artwork guide

Getting your artwork right first time means a sharper sign and a faster turnaround. No file? Our studio can help.

  • Best file types: vector files (AI, EPS, SVG or a PDF exported from design software) give razor-sharp results at any size. High-resolution JPG, PNG or TIFF files work for photos.
  • Resolution: for photos and raster images, aim for at least 150dpi at the final printed size (300dpi for small signs viewed close up). Images taken from websites or social media are usually too small.
  • Colours: set artwork up in CMYK. If your brand has Pantone or RAL references, tell us and we'll match them as closely as the material allows.
  • Fonts: convert text to outlines or embed fonts in your PDF, so the lettering prints exactly as designed.
  • Bleed and margins: add 3 to 5mm bleed around printed panels and keep important text at least 10mm from the edge.
  • Cut-to-shape signs: include the cut line as a separate vector path. If you don't have one, our studio will create it.
  • No artwork? Send us your logo, wording and any brand guidelines and our design studio will lay it out for you. You'll see a proof before anything is made.
Questions

Clear Acrylic Sign with Printed Logo FAQs

Can't see your question? Call 01603 407786 or send an enquiry.

Is acrylic the same as Perspex?

Yes. Perspex is a well-known brand of acrylic sheet, and the two names are used interchangeably.

Spot white or flood white?

Spot white puts white only behind your logo, keeping the background clear. Flood white backs the whole panel, giving a solid white sign. Spot white suits coloured walls; flood white guarantees maximum colour on any wall.

Which thickness should I choose?

5mm suits most wall signs. Choose 10mm for a premium reception look, especially with stand-offs, and 3mm for small signs.

Can it go outside?

Yes. Because the print is on the back, it's protected from the weather.

What file do I need to send?

A vector logo (AI, EPS, SVG or a PDF from design software) gives the sharpest result. Send what you have and we'll check it, or our studio can redraw it.
